styles.empty: The book has no stylesheet. Add a selector to create one.
styles.groupTip: A stylesheet of the book; a new selector goes into the selected stylesheet, else into the default one
styles.ruleTip: A rule: select it to edit its declarations
styles.faulty: This stylesheet holds CSS the editor cannot read; it is kept exactly as read.
styles.otherType: This stylesheet is not CSS; it is kept exactly as read.
styles.addTip: Add a style: for every element of one kind (all paragraphs, all section titles…) or a named style you put on chosen text yourself
styles.newTip: Add an empty CSS stylesheet to the book

reason.matchesNothing: Matches nothing in an FB2 book: {{detail}}

styles.applyTip: Write these declarations into the rule ({{keys}})
styles.applyRefused: Correct the declarations listed below first
styles.hint: Select a rule to edit its declarations, or add a selector.
styles.noDocument: Styles view - no document is open.

named.applyTip: Apply the named style .{{name}} to the selected text, or to the element at the caret

reason.none: No named style is defined: add a class selector in the Styles view
reason.bodyView: Named styles are applied in the Body view
reason.noTarget: Select text, or put the caret in a paragraph, verse, subtitle, text author, table or cell
reason.nothingToRemove: There is no named style here

styles.editorHint: Type the declarations of {{selector}}, for example text-indent: 1.5em; — {{keys}} writes them into the rule

addStyle.caption: Add style
addStyle.elementTip: A style for every element of one kind in the book - all paragraphs, all section titles, all verses. Choose the element in the list on the right
addStyle.elementListTip: Choose an FB2 element; typing narrows the list. A combination such as "epigraph p" can be typed too
addStyle.elementPlaceholder: Type to search, for example paragraph
addStyle.optionTip: Style every {{label}} of the book (the FB2 selector {{selector}})
addStyle.namedTip: A style you put on chosen text or elements yourself: once it has declarations, Style > Named Style lists it
addStyle.nameTip: The style's name: letters, digits, hyphens or underscores; the dot of a class is added for you
addStyle.resultNone: Choose an element or type a name
addStyle.badName: A name uses letters, digits, hyphens and underscores and does not start with a digit
addStyle.okTip: Create the rule; its declarations are typed next, in the box on the right

styles.applyNothing: Nothing to write: the box holds the rule's declarations as they are
